hypothesis: Transmitting complete next-symbol counts for profitable decoder-visible two-byte WRT contexts and coding those subsequences without replacement saves at least 2000 exact bytes on opening 1M.
interfaces_exposed: Two-byte causal WRT context, exact p16 parent trace, sparse transmitted count vectors, and one shared side range stream.
kill_condition: No context has positive paid ideal contribution, any exact replay fails, or measured net is below 2000 bytes per million raw.
promotion_condition: Exact parent identity, nonempty side-coder roundtrip, exact WRT reconstruction, and at least 2000 net bytes per million raw after complete source accounting.
rejection_reason: No context has positive paid ideal contribution. The best context is -31.335846 bits before the shared frame, finite-coder overhead, or source cost; exact optimum is the parent.
title: Paid context-two conditional multinomial fibers
